# Repair cafe parts in the wrong cupboard

The repair cafe spare switches went into the locked office during cleaning. We had stocked the part but made it unavailable to the people who fit it. Label the box with its use and leave the safe consumables at the bench. [[Maintenance]] needs to distinguish secure storage from storage that quietly defeats the work.
